error[L0301]: an `else` value stands in for this call's plain pointer, and does not widen it into `absent | denied | ptr mut u32`
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/pointer-union-many-call-else-atom-names-the-route/program.ldn:17:57

  |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the successful call result
  = note: D235: recover into `absent | ptr mut u32` first, whose value widens into this union
